note: Per-image draft decisions, not accepted. Adjacent earlier/later scenes and actual movement, geometry and captions remain unverified.

scenes.observation: Three distinct lifeboat hulls surround people and supplies. The large oar leads into the supplies; the right-hand mast is cropped at the original upper edge.

camera.subject: resources and all three hulls
camera.reason: Bring attention to the central supplies while preserving the boats; the paddle is secondary.

scenes.observation: Four men lean forward connected by a taut rope to a single empty boat; boat and men span most of the width.

camera.subject: rope connection between boat and men
camera.reason: Widen the view to preserve the full human effort and the boat.

scenes.observation: Four men on the ridge pull a rope that is visibly tied to the grounded bow; the boat and ridge touch at the obstacle. Mast already leaves the top edge.

camera.subject: contact between grounded bow and ridge
camera.reason: Direct attention to the point where the hull catches on ice; avoid cropping the towing team.

scenes.observation: Small figures and a boat are surrounded by fractured ice and dark open cracks. Their small scale serves the journey, but individual expressions cannot be assessed from this view.

camera.subject: boat team surrounded by broken floes
camera.reason: Reveal the width of the broken ice and the group’s small scale.

scenes.observation: Five visible men and a camp share one enlarged floe with three separate resting boat hulls.

camera.subject: boats and camp on a single floe
camera.reason: Draw the viewer toward the camp without losing the floe edges or boat count.

scenes.observation: Three boats and tents form a small camp amid a broad floe, with an editorial arrow on the ice.

camera.subject: isolated floe and camp
camera.reason: Expand the field to emphasize isolation; the arrow is schematic, not a precise route.

scenes.observation: Hands divide small food portions while a man works by a boat in the background.

camera.subject: food portions and hands
camera.reason: Focus on rationing while retaining the active boat in the background.

scenes.observation: Tent, people and a lifeboat rest on floes separated by dark cracks; nobody is visible in the water.

camera.subject: breaks in ice near the camp
camera.reason: Reveal the surrounding cracks and maintain physical separation from the people.
